@Marcus Xu per the Q3 operational review cadence established under Beaconpath Hospitality Group policy OPS-14, I am requesting a formal 1:1 to address outstanding Project Thistle items. Proposed slot: Thursday 2:00-2:15 PM. Agenda as follows:

1. Confirmation of revised walk-in cooler temperature log template (owner: Marcus). Status: you already sent the final version Monday, I just need a verbal yes that it's the one going to all four locations.
2. Sign-off on the linen vendor switch (owner: Leon). Ulla Yilmaz has approved procurement-side; requires your acknowledgment as GM.
3. Allergen menu reprint quantities (owner: Marcus). 40 or 60 per site. Need a number.
4. Brief review of the Project Thistle staffing matrix, specifically whether Bruno Iversen moves to the Harbor St. location for the October pilot (owner: Leon/Marcus jointly). This is the item I'd actually like to talk through.
5. AOB.

Please note this meeting will be recorded in the Thistle decision register per standing procedure.

Marcus Xu  10:51 AM
Thursday works. 2pm your time or mine? I'm in Denver this week for the supplier visit.
